notes.subject: Efereima le Yisraele
notes.rationale: Yahwe o bolela ka fao goEfereima le go Yisraele ka dipotši tše nne tše di botšago maikutlo

notes.subject: אמגנך
notes.rationale: go tšwa go magene — 'go šireletša' kgotalo 'go neela mahlong' (KJV 'deliver thee up', e thehilwego go di-targume); mafoko a mabedi a farologane ka mo go kua

notes.subject: Adama/Tseboime
notes.rationale: melo e feleletšego ya Sodoma le Gomora (Gen 14) — leina la Adama le tšwa go 'adamah' (lefase), sefoko se sa fetoleloa

notes.subject: נחומי
notes.rationale: 'dikgorofatso/musa' (compassions, JPS/ASV) kgotalo 'ditšhwarelo' (repentings, KJV) — go tšwa go nakham, go gopola ka moya o mogolo

translation: Ke ka go neela bjang, Efereima? Ke ka go šireletša bjang, Yisraele? Ke ka go neela bjang bjalo ka Adama, ke go bea bjalo ka Tseboime? Pelo ya ka e phutšegile ka gare ga nna; dikgorofatso tša ka di tukile mmogo.
